info.title: MetroMatrix API
info.description: Zero-commission community marketplace: Shopping, Healthcare, Food. Every response is enveloped: { success, data } or { success: false, error: { code, message, details? } }.

avatarUrl.description: A URL from an upload signed for purpose "avatar" (your avatar folder on our Cloudinary), or null to remove.
A URL from an upload signed for purpose "avatar", as for PATCH /users/me.

password.description: At least 8 characters with a lower-case letter, an upper-case letter and a digit.

phone.description: Pakistani mobile. Accepts 03XXXXXXXXX, +923XXXXXXXXX or 923XXXXXXXXX (spaces/dashes allowed); stored as +923XXXXXXXXX.

challengeToken.description: From the admin-portal sign-in response (5 minutes).

recoveryCode.description: One of the recovery codes shown at enrolment, instead of `code`.

idToken.description: The Google ID token from Google Sign-In on web, Android or iOS (audience = one of GOOGLE_CLIENT_IDS).

refreshToken.description: The refresh token from the last AuthResult.

token.description: The token from the emailed link (metromatrix://verify-email?token=…).

currentPassword.description: Required when the account has a password.

idToken.description: A fresh Google ID token — required for a Google-only account (no password) setting its first one.
A fresh Google ID token — for Google-only accounts, which have no password.

pmdcNumber.description: Doctors only — the PMDC registration number. Required before submitting.
Doctors only — the PMDC registration number. Required before submitting.

documentNotes.description: Per-document notes; each named document is marked rejected.

code.description: A code from the newly added authenticator.

currentCode.description: Rotation only (TOTP already enabled): a code from the CURRENT authenticator, so a stolen session cannot replace it.

logoUrl.description: From an upload signed for purpose store_branding.

coverUrl.description: From an upload signed for purpose store_branding.
